visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: StringBuilder.reverse Instead of Concatenation in a Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A String is built one character at a time with +, which copies the text on every step. Use StringBuilder's reverse. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Strings are immutable, so each + creates a new String and copies everything built so far, which makes the loop slow for long text. StringBuilder works on a single buffer, and reverse() does the whole job.
